findings.reason: without a terminal rule for a conflicting pending plan the node implements an unbounded retry loop that reports a failure the portfolio no longer has, replacing §9's "success on a stale move" with "partial forever on a consistent one", and the done-when's conflict case asserts only that conflict is reported, not that it ever resolves.
findings.text: the conflict clause says a plan whose version moved "stays pending and the retry names it as conflicting", while "success is recorded only once no plan is pending" elsewhere in the same section, so a conflicting entry can never clear: every subsequent retry returns `partial_write` forever even after the other call has left the index and the plan agreeing on the other call's sprint, and the plan states no rule that reconciles or retires the entry
